fusions.name: Hoof Drum
fusions.desc: Drums the ground around you, dealing 8 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles. You hold 4 charges and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Unflagging Cuffs
fusions.desc: A quick cuff that deals 4 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds. You move 15% faster for 3 seconds after using it.

fusions.name: Mile After Mile
fusions.desc: Restores 3 stamina a second for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Steady Gait
fusions.desc: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 10%.
